senses.gloss: f. (נָשָׂא, Hif.) = הֶסֵּיעַ, diverting the mind from a question which must not be answered, a Biblical puzzle of interpretation used for diverting the mind.—Pl. הֶשֵּׂיאוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:7:1">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>השיאו</he>, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:8">Ab. Zar. II, 8</cite>) he ought to have diverted his mind by means of one <he>מחמש ה׳ בתורה</he> of the five puzzles &c., v. <cite ref="E00525"><he>הַכְרָעָה</he></cite>.
